compliance_notes: Read on 2026-11-02 from the official API repository: remote jobs only, delayed by 24 hours, with a search, company and category filter. Rules stated there: link back to the job and name Remotive as the source or access may be ended, do not send the jobs to other job sites (it names Jooble, Google Jobs and LinkedIn Jobs), and do not display jobs in order to collect sign-ups or email addresses. Provenance requires an account, so whether showing Remotive jobs to signed-in users counts as collecting sign-ups is a decision for the owner, or a question for Remotive. The website terms page could not be located. Restricted until decided.
